## Photovoltaic Potential (PV)

```{r}
#| label: setup-solar
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/solar/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-solar
#| include: false
monthly_pv <- tryCatch({
  pv_file <- str_subset(list.files(tabular_dir, full = T), "solar_monthly_stats\\.csv")
  if (length(pv_file) == 0) stop("No solar monthly stats file found")
  read_csv(pv_file[1], col_types = "dddd")
}, error = function(e) { message("Monthly PV not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: solar-pv
#| results: asis

if (is.null(monthly_pv) || nrow(monthly_pv) == 0) print_text(paste_bold('No PV data available')) else {

  pv_plot <- monthly_pv %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mean)) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 4.6, label = "Excellent Conditions", vjust = 0, hjust = 0, color = "dark grey") +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 3.6, label = "Favorable Conditions", vjust = 0, hjust = 0, color = "dark grey") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = lubridate::month(1:12, label = T) %>% as.character) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.05))) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal availability of solar energy",
        x = "Month", y = "Daily PV energy yield (kWh/kWp") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(3.5, 4.5), linetype = "dotted") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "monthly-pv.png"), device = "png",
        width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(pv_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  monthly_pv %>% print_paged_df()
}
```
